# project conventions (CLAUDE.md):
# Tomorrow — Quick Start for Coding Agents

## Tech Stack
- **Nuxt 3** / **Nitro** / **Vue 3** SFC / **Prisma** / **Supabase** (PostgreSQL)
- **TypeScript** (ES2023, strict mode), **Tailwind**, **Chart.js**, **Zod** validation
- **Tests**: Vitest (run via `npm test`)
- **Node 22.x**

## Directory Map
| Dir | Purpose |
|-----|---------|
| `pages/` | Vue SFC routes (nested = nested routes); `pages/app/` = authed, `pages/` = public |
| `server/api/` | Nitro API handlers; `requireAuth`/`requireVerifiedUser` guard all sensitive routes |
| `server/utils/` | Pure business logic + domain engines; **no I/O, no Date.now()** |
| `server/tasks/` | Nitro cron/scheduled-task handlers (also in vercel.json) |
| `server/plugins/` | Nitro server plugins (KV hydration, DB checks) |
| `components/` | Reusable Vue components; `components/app/` = main UI, `components/ui/` = design system |
| `composables/` | Vue composables (hooks); `useFetch`, `useAuth`, domain-specific |
| `prisma/` | Schema + migrations; **migrations are versioned + checksummed** (never edit applied migrations) |
| `scripts/` | Bash/Node tooling: linters, audits, provisioning (NOT run autonomously) |
| `types/` | Shared TypeScript types |

## Build / Test / Lint
```sh
npm run dev                  # Nuxt dev server (port 3000); env vars from .env
npm run build               # Prod build (runs migrations first if DATABASE_URL set)
npm test                    # Vitest all tests (runs both pure + DB-backed)
npm run lint:migrations     # Verify migration names vs schema (catches naming bugs)
npm run lint:syntax         # Check all .ts/.js syntax (no ts exec)
npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck  # Type-check entire project
npx vitest run --config vitest.pure.config.ts  # Pure tests only (no DB)
```

## Code Conventions (Observed, Not Enforced)
- **DB names**: snake_case tables (`@@map("live_clause_edits")`), camelCase columns quoted (`"roomId"`, `"bridgeStatus"`)
- **Code**: camelCase identifiers; PascalCase classes/types; CONST_CAPS for immutable config
- **Migration names**: `20260603000000_feature_name` (timestamp + kebab-case slug); immutable once applied
- **Prisma models**: match schema names; use `@map("col")` on fields only if table uses `@@map`; add `@db.Timestamptz(6)` for dates, `@db.Uuid` for UUIDs
- **Pure functions**: no `Date.now()`, no `Math.random()`, no file I/O—pass time/seed via params
- **Comments**: only document WHY (non-obvious invariants, workarounds); don't comment WHAT
- **Tests**: assert +

+import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
+import {
+  createAggregate,
+  addContribution,
+  computeCalibrationError,
+  runFederatedCalibration,
+  type BookContribution,
+  type GroundTruth,
+} from '../federatedCalibration'
+
+/* ---------- helpers ------------------------------------------------------- */
+
+const GROUND_TRUTH: GroundTruth = {
+  residualES: 0.04,
+  basis: 0.015,
+  pd: 0.02,
+}
+
+/** Generate N synthetic books whose means converge to ground truth. */
+function syntheticBooks(n: number): BookContribution[] {
+  return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => ({
+    contributorId: `book-${i}`,
+    residualES: GROUND_TRUTH.residualES + (i % 2 === 0 ? 0.005 : -0.005),
+    basis: GROUND_TRUTH.basis + (i % 2 === 0 ? 0.002 : -0.002),
+    pd: GROUND_TRUTH.pd + (i % 2 === 0 ? 0.003 : -0.003),
+  }))
+}
+
+describe('Federated calibration', () => {
+  describe('k-anonymity suppression', () => {
+    it('suppresses results below k-anonymity threshold', () => {
+      const books = syntheticBooks(3)
+      const k = 5
+      let agg = createAggregate(k)
+
+      for (const b of books) {
+        agg = addContribution(agg, b)
+      }
+
+      const metric = computeCalibrationError(agg, GROUND_TRUTH)
+      expect(metric.released).toBe(false)
+      expect(metric.calibrationError).toBe(Infinity)
+      expect(metric.n).toBe(3)
+    })
+
+    it('releases results once k threshold is met', () => {
+      const books = syntheticBooks(5)
+      const k = 5
+      let agg = createAggregate(k)
+
+      for (const b of books) {
+        agg = addContribution(agg, b)
+      }
+
+      const metric = computeCalibrationError(agg, GROUND_TRUTH)
+      expect(metric.released).toBe(true)
+      expect(metric.calibrationError).toBeLessThan(Infinity)
+      expect(metric.n).toBe(5)
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('calibration error convergence', () => {
+    it('calibration error is monotone non-increasing as N grows (past k)', () => {
+      const books = syntheticBooks(40)
+      const k = 5
+      const metrics = runFederatedCalibration(books, GROUND_TRUTH, k)
+
+      // Only check released metrics (n >= k)
+      const released = metrics.filter((m) => m.released)
+      expect(released.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
+
+      for (let i = 1; i < released.length; i++) {
+        expect(released[i].calibrationError).toBeLessThanOrEqual(
+          released[i - 1].calibrationError + 1e-12, // floating-point tolerance
+        )
+      }
+    })
+
+    it('calibration error decreases substantially with many contributors', () => {
+      const smallBooks = syntheticBooks(6)
+      const largeBooks = syntheticBooks(50)
+      const k = 5
+
+      const smallMetrics = runFederatedCalibration(smallBooks, GROUND_TRUTH, k)
+      const largeMetrics = runFederatedCalibration(largeBooks, GROUND_TRUTH, k)
+
+      const smallError = smallMetrics[smallMetrics.length - 1].calibrationError
+      const largeError = largeMetrics[largeMetrics.length - 1].calibrationError
+
+      expect(largeError).toBeLessThan(smallError)
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('individual contribution non-recoverability', () => {
+    it('cannot recover an individual contribution by subtracting aggregates', () => {
+      const books = syntheticBooks(10)
+      const k = 5
+      const target = books[7] // arbitrary contributor
+
+      // Build aggregate WITH the target
+      let aggWith = createAggregate(k)
+      for (const b of books) {
+        aggWith = addContribution(aggWith, b)
+      }
+
+      // Build aggregate WITHOUT the target
+      let aggWithout = createAggregate(k)
+      for (const b of books) {
+        if (b.contributorId !== target.contributorId) {
+          aggWithout = addContribution(aggWithout, b)
+        }
+      }
+
+      // Naive difference should NOT equal the target's original values
+      // because noise was injected independently per-step
+      const diffES = aggWith.sumResidualES - aggWithout.sumResidualES
+      const diffBasis = aggWith.sumBasis - aggWithout.sumBasis
+      const diffPD = aggWith.sumPD - aggWithout.sumPD
+
+      // At least one dimension should differ from the true value
+      const esMatch = Math.abs(diffES - target.residualES) < 1e-10
+      const basisMatch = Math.abs(diffBasis - target.basis) < 1e-10
+      const pdMatch = Math.abs(diffPD - target.pd) < 1e-10
+
+      expect(esMatch && basisMatch && pdMatch).toBe(false)
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('duplicate contributor handling', () => {
+    it('ignores duplicate contributor ids', () => {
+      const book: BookContribution = {
+        contributorId: 'dup-1',
+        residualES: 0.04,
+        basis: 0.015,
+        pd: 0.02,
+      }
+
+      let agg = createAggregate(2)
+      agg = addContribution(agg, book)
+      agg = addContribution(agg, book) // duplicate
+      expect(agg.n).toBe(1)
+    })
+  })
+})

+ *
+ * Each participant contributes calibration statistics without exposing
+ * individual positions. The aggregate uses additive noise injection and
+ * enforces k-anonymity: results are suppressed until at least K distinct
+ * contributors have been folded in.
+ */

+
+/** Calibration accuracy metric paired with contributor count. */
+export interface FederatedCalibrationMetric {
+  /** Number of distinct contributors folded into the aggregate. */
+  n: number
+  /** Mean absolute calibration error (lower is better). */
+  calibrationError: number
+  /** Whether the metric has been released (k-anonymity satisfied). */
+  released: boolean
+}
+
+/** Per-book contribution — summary statistics only, never raw positions. */

+  contributorId: string

+  residualES: number
+  /** Basis spread estimate. */
